status.main_product: Busbar energy distribution systems, cable trays, and data center physical infrastructure solutions
status.scope_reason: The company manufactures and sells data center power distribution systems (busbars) and rack cabinets under its own name.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website, EAE Elektrik A.Ş. is active and manufactures data center products including busbar power distribution systems and rack cabinets.

claims.claim: The company reports that its KabinPLUS Cold Aisle Containment (CAC) and Hot Aisle Containment (HAC) systems provide up to 40% energy savings by isolating hot and cold airflows in white space environments, according to EAE Electrotechnics.
claims.source: KabinPLUS Aisle Containment Solutions | EAE Electric (https://www.eaeelectric.com/data-center-rack-cabinet/kabinplus-aisle-containment-solutions) & Aisle Containment Solutions | KabinPLUS (https://eaeelektroteknik.com)

claims.claim: In a 2024 project installation at a 20-story commercial tower in Gulshan, Dhaka, the client deployed EAE Elektrik's E-Line MK and CR Series busbar systems, which successfully achieved a reduction in voltage drop over long distances.
claims.source: EAE BBT Supplier in Bangladesh - Ekra Cargo (https://ekracargo.com)

claims.claim: EAE Elektrik offers its KabinPLUS KD Series Modular 19" Data Center Rack Cabinets with a static and dynamic load capacity of 1,500 kg, designed to support heavy equipment configurations like multi-GPU blade assemblies, paired with an 85% perforation rate for high-density airflow.
claims.source: KD Series - Data Center Rack Cabinets - EAE Elektroteknik (https://eaeelektroteknik.com/en/products/kabinplus/kd-series-data-center-rack-cabinets) & KabinPLUS KD Server & KD Network - EAE Electric (https://www.eaeelectric.com/ru/data-center-rack-cabinet/kd-server-network-rack-cabinet)

claims.claim: EAE Elektrik reports that its KabinPLUS aisle containment solutions isolate hot and cold air to support dense computing arrangements by blocking up to 99% of air leaks, while physical security is managed via integrated biometric or electronic four-point locking systems.
claims.source: KD Series - Data Center Rack Cabinets - EAE Elektroteknik (https://eaeelektroteknik.com/en/products/kabinplus/kd-series-data-center-rack-cabinets) & Aisle Containment Solutions | KabinPLUS (https://eaeelektroteknik.com)

claims.claim: The company reports that its data center solutions include intelligent tap-off boxes designed to measure and monitor energy consumption, energy quality, and temperature via RS485 or TCP/IP connections, enabling integration with data center infrastructure management (DCIM) systems as described in the EAE Elektrik Data Center Solutions Overview.

The company reports real-time monitoring of energy consumption, energy quality, and temperature within its data center tap-off boxes over RS485 or TCP/IP connections to maintain operational sustainability.
claims.source: EAE Elektrik - Data Center Solutions Official Video Presentation

claims.claim: Eae Elektrik Asansor Endustrisi Insaat A.S. reported a net sales revenue increase of 96.44% in fiscal year 2025, according to a company profile by EMIS.
claims.source: Eae Elektrik Asansor Endustrisi Insaat A.S. Company Profile - Turkiye (EMIS)

claims.claim: The company's E-Line KX Aluminium 4000 A low-voltage busbar system was selected as the designated transformer busbar component integrated within Eaton's NordicEPOD 2.0 MW modular data center platform architecture, as verified in Eaton's technical product specifications.
claims.corrected: The company's E-Line KX Aluminium 5000 A low-voltage busbar system was selected as the designated transformer busbar component integrated within Eaton's NordicEPOD 2.0 MW modular data center platform architecture, as verified in Eaton's technical product specifications.
claims.source: Eaton Modular Data Center G A Critical Power Skid Technical Specifications

claims.claim: The company collaborated with localized regional channel partners, such as IIGM in India, to co-showcase and market its electrical power distribution solutions at industry trade events like DCD Connect India 2026.
claims.source: IIGM Official Announcement on LinkedIn & Instagram regarding DCD Connect India 2026

claims.claim: In its 2025 financial disclosures, Eae Elektrik Asansor Endustrisi Insaat Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi recorded significant growth in Turkey, achieving a 96.44% increase in net sales revenue alongside a 202.4% surge in operating profit.
claims.source: Eae Elektrik Asansor Endustrisi Insaat A.S. Company Profile - Turkiye (EMIS)

claims.claim: The company reports that its busbar products are certified by KEMA/DEKRA (Holland), KEMA-KEUR, and UL classified laboratories under IEC 61439-1/6 standards.

The company reports that it maintains ISO 50001 energy management and ISO 14064-1 greenhouse gas verification certifications, and its state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities are LEED Gold certified.

The company reports that it increases energy efficiency in data center environments by utilizing an open chimney system made of aluminum frames with polycarbonate material to form a "Hot Aisle" for hot and cold air insulation.

The company reports through its subsidiary EAE Elektroteknik that its KabinPLUS KD Server and KD Network rack cabinets feature a 1,500 kg static load capacity in compliance with EN 61587-1 and UL 2416, according to the EAE Electric product specifications.

The company reports through its subsidiary EAE Elektroteknik that its KabinPLUS KD Server and KD Network rack cabinets provide an optional 1,500 kg dynamic load capacity using heavy-duty casters certified under UL 2413 and UL 1678, according to the EAE Electric product specifications.

The company reports through its subsidiary EAE Elektroteknik that its EdgeBLOK MDC Micro Data Center utilizes a 5U height in-rack cooling unit featuring DX cooling capacity options of 3.2 kW and 4 kW, with an emergency peak capacity of 4.5 kW, according to EAE Elektroteknik product specifications.

The company reports through its subsidiary EAE Elektroteknik that its data center panels and cabinets achieve the highest level of mechanical impact protection with an IK10 rating, according to EAE Electrotechnics industry solutions.

The company reports through its subsidiary EAE Elektroteknik that its KabinPLUS KD Series racks are certified for seismic resistance by internationally accredited laboratories in compliance with the EN 61587-2 standard, according to the EAE Electric product specifications.
The company reports its global footprint covers more than 30,000 projects across 150+ countries.
claims.corrected: The company reports its global footprint covers projects across 150+ countries.

claims.claim: The company reports supplying seismic racks, seismic platforms, and cold aisle containment for the 200kW OYAK Dragos Data Center project in Turkey.

The company reports supplying seismic racks, co-location racks, shared cabinets, hot corridor containment/cold aisle containment, containment hanging systems, containment lighting, seismic platforms, and seismic anchorage for Module 1 (3MW / 8MW) of the Turkcell Europe Data Center project in Turkey.
The company reports that EAE products are used in more than 100 countries worldwide (EAE Technology).
The company lists the DSP 3' Data Center Project in Russia as a data center reference (EAE Italia Data Center Solutions Brochure).
The company reports operating 370,000 m² of enclosed space across 8 active factories and 3 R&D centers, as stated by EAE Electric.
The company operates with 100% domestic capital and conducts in-house R&D product development, as stated by EAE Technology.
In 2025, the company reported a net sales revenue increase of 96.44%, total asset growth of 63.23%, and a net profit margin increase of 12.59%, as verified by EMIS.
The company holds over 30 patents, 300 brands, and 100 industrial designs, as stated by EAE Technology.

The company reports supporting its innovation capabilities with an intellectual property portfolio of more than 50 patents, over 300 trademarks, and over 150 industrial design registrations, as shown on the EAE Electric About Page.
The company lists the DSP 3' Data Center Project in Russia as a data center reference.
